Name: Animal Color Picker
Author: tbonehunter
Description: When purchasing chickens or cows, the game assigns a color to the animal, which may or may not be the color you need or prefer. Chicken color determines the egg color, which is a Community Center Bundle fulfillment issue. Cows aren't as big a deal but some of us like a balanced demographic. This mod allows the farmer to choose the animal's color prior to placing it in the coop or barn. For those who want blue chickens at Shane's 8 heart event, or want the colors and textures of other mods, selecting "Random" will exit this mod to the vanilla game selection of random colors.

Downloads.Description: Allows choice of white, brown or random (uses vanilla game random assignment of color including blue when available) for chickens and cows.
